The material.

Asset reference: "asset:<uuid>", "asset:<uuid>#<sub-path>" or "builtin:<kind>/<name>" (see asset.list).

mesh.description:
The mesh.

mobility.description: Whether it moves, as a hint for the shadow cache (M4 4.7b); `Auto` watches it move.

MeshRenderer.title: MeshRenderer

Mobility.description:
How a mesh moves, a hint for virtual shadow maps' cache (M4 4.7b). A wrong hint never
changes the picture, only the cost.

oneOf.description: Dynamic while it has moved in the last 60 frames, static otherwise.

Kept in the static pages even when it moves (each move redraws them): for things that
move once.
Drawn into the dynamic pages from its first frame: doors, platforms, projectiles.

Mobility.title: Mobility

description:
Draws rigid pieces of shared meshes (a broken breakable's parts, M8 8.5b): each vertex's
first joint is its piece, and only the pieces in `shown` appear.

meshes.description: The meshes, each with its material (a breakable's surface and interior).

pieces.description: How many pieces the meshes hold.
